text: The published decisions page (https://doodla.github.io/athena/decisions.html) lists steward proposals that were already decided as 'waiting for your decision'. On 3 Nov it showed 3 waiting: work item 20261016-055247-qyd9 was approved on 30 Oct (job 20261030-081751-edsg), 20261017-204324-jtd2 was rejected, and 20261018-000648-ne91 is within the steward's own limit, so it is not the owner's decision at all. Show only proposals that are still open and above the steward's limit; when there are none, say 'Nothing waiting for you' in one line. Acceptance: a test where an approved, a rejected, and a within-limit proposal produce 'Nothing waiting for you'; a test where one open above-limit proposal produces one card.
